product_metadata.title: Comfort Spaces Plush to Sherpa Electric Blanket Shawl Shoulder, Neck Wrap with Matching Sock Set, Giftable Ultra Soft, Warm, Snuggle Fleece-Reversible Heated Poncho Throw, 50" W x 64" L, Animal Print
features: Be comfortable and cozy anytime and anywhere you like with our Comfort Spaces Plush to Sherpa heated wearable electric blanket shoulder and neck wrap
Discover the ultimate comfort of our reversible fleece to sherpa blanket. Soft, cozy, and travel-friendly, it's perfect for lounging, office use, and on-the-go warmth

Our product is UL certified and includes a 2 hour auto shut off for safety. Input Voltage: 120V/60Hz and compatible with 2 prong plug. We offer a 5 year warranty, so you can use our product with confidence
Our 3 heat levels to find your comfort zone of your plush electric wrap throw. The 50' x 64" wrap fits comfortably around your body
Machine Washable, soak the bedding, agitate on low, rinse in cool water, and spin on low. Avoid using bleach. Tumble dry low, do not iron
description: Rest easy with the Comfort Spaces Heated Snuggle Wrap. Made from ultra soft plush fabric with an ivory micro Berber reverse, this heated wrap is incredibly soft to the touch. 3 heat settings allow you to chose the perfect temperature. UL Certified for safety, this wrap emits virtually no electromagnetic field emissions and has a 2 hour auto shut off for the ultimate in safety. Easy care and machine washable.
